items.label: 10.1 Inch HD Display
items.value: BINTEC tablet has a 92% high screen occupancy rate, 1920 x 1200 IPS and a high resolution touch screen with vivid colors that provide an immersive viewing experience when watching TV shows, movies, and games.The processor is powered by Celeron J3455 to keep the computer running smoothly

items.label: Thin and Portable
items.value: Our two-in-one tablet computer is 25.3×17.8×1.8 cm in overall size, 24.5×16.8×0.7cm in size for the tablet, the tablet is detachable, and the body weighs only 0.6kg. Easy to carry and operate, combining the functionality of a touch screen tablet with the practicality and efficiency of a laptop, making it a great choice for on-the-go

items.label: Multifunctional Connection
items.value: Supports wireless 5G WIFI and 4.2 Bluetooth, in addition, it also supports USB 3.0, Type-C, mini HDMI, headphone/microphone port and TF card slot, allowing you to connect to various media devices.It also features a 1.9 megapixel camera in the front and back, so you can easily take photos and make video calls

items: 8GB RAM + Large Storage Equipped with 8GB of RAM and 256GB SSD (expandable with TF card expansion). This is a full-featured ultraportable computer suitable for office, school, and home use. Equipped with 5G and Wi-Fi high-speed wireless networks, you can enjoy the internet smoothly.

items.label: 365 Days Limited Warranty
items.value: Package includes tablet x 1, power adapter x 1, English instruction manual x 1, and warranty card x 1.
